# Riso Film , procedural risograph animations as self-contained HTML plus verified MP4

Curated by Skill Harbor: a complete method for making procedural risograph films: pick a direction, prove the hardest frame first, build from a clean Canvas 2D engine, review picture and motion with real tooling, then export a verified MP4. Every pixel is drawn in code, the deliverable is one self-contained HTML file with no libraries, fonts, images or network calls, and the workflow includes quality gates for flicker, jitter and pacing. by @sevenevesai, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: one of a trio (riso-still for still art, riso-score for sound; this one is the film builder); expects Node.js and the repo's render/review scripts, and a real render engine for MP4 export. Artistic judgment stays yours: the skill proves technical validity, not beauty. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
